run_f_gold: run f_gold to censor a specific word in a sentence with asterisks
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameterized test cases for word censoring
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use str.replace instead of split and join for censoring
review_f_gold: review f_gold logic for replacing words with asterisks of equal length
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which censors occurrences of a word in a sentence
